Regular City Council Meeting
CONSOLIDATED AGENDA
February 12, 2013
05:30 P.M.
CALL TO ORDER - City Council Chambers, 200 Civic Center Drive, Vista, California
ROLL CALL
PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE AND INVOCATION - Dr. Charlie Bradshaw, North Coast Church
BROWN ACT NOTICE OF SIMULTANEOUS MEETING COMPENSATION
APPROVAL OF AGENDA
CLOSED SESSION
CS.
Reports on action taken in Closed Session
PRESENTATIONS
P1.
Law Enforcement Awards
P2.
Proclamation declaring Wednesday, February 13, 2013, "Sergeant Scott Black Day" in the City of Vista
P3.
Vista Community Clinic Health Food Availability Assessment Presentation
CONSENT CALENDAR
C1.
Check Register (CC)
C2.
Approval of Minutes (CC/CDC/SA/BSD)
C3.
Treasurer's Cash Report for Month Ended December 31, 2012 (CC)
C4.
Vista Village Business Association Special Event Banner Signs for St. Patrick's Day / Festival and the Main Street Farmer's Market (CC)
C5.
Amendment to the Agreement with Chef DK for the Food and Beverage Services at the Moonlight Amphitheatre (CC)
DISCUSSION
D1.
Sewer Service Rates (CC/BSD)
1.
Set Public Hearing for April 23, 2013, to receive testimony regarding the proposed sewer service rates;
2.
Adopt City Council Resolution No. 2013- , approving the Sewer Financial Plan and Rate Study from Raftelis Financial Consultants, Inc.; and
3.
Adopt Buena Sanitation District Resolution No. 2013- , approving the Sewer Financial Plan and Rate Study from Raftelis Financial Consultants, Inc.
D2.
Fiscal Year 2012/13 Second Quarter Financial Report (CC)
1.
Receive the report;
2.
Adopt City Council Resolution No. 2013- , amending the Operating Program Budget for FY 2012/13; and
3.
Adopt City Council Resolution No. 2013- , amending the Capital Improvement Program Budget for FY
2012/13.
PUBLIC HEARING
PH1.
Disposition and Development/Affordable Housing Agreement with Affirmed Housing Group (Paseo Family Housing, L.P.) (CC/CDC)
1.
Open, conduct, and close a public hearing to consider the terms of a Disposition and Development/Affordable Housing Agreement with Paseo Family Housing, L.P.; (Recommendation continued on following page)
(Recommendation continued from previous page)
2.
Adopt Community Development Commission Resolution No. 2013- , approving a Disposition and Development/Affordable Housing Agreement by and among the Commission, the City of Vista, and Paseo Family Housing L.P., A California Limited Partnership; and
3.
Adopt City Council Resolution No. 2013- , approving a Disposition and Development/Affordable Housing Agreement by and among the Community Development Commission of the City of Vista, the City of Vista, and Paseo Family Housing L.P., A California Limited Partnership.
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS
REMARKS
R1.
Reports from members of the governing bodies on outside committee meetings.
R2.
Reports and comments from City officials and members of the governing bodies.
ADJOURNMENT
